approvalScope: The verified 1.3.10 visual system, DCR-2026-001 Reports Intelligence hierarchy, and DCR-2026-002 Management Command Center are locked for future changes. Every visible Reports control must remain connected to PostgreSQL-backed API behavior.
changeRule: A design change requires a Design Change Request approved by Gaurav Mehta. DCR-2026-001 and DCR-2026-002 are the approved amendments to Design System v1.0.
releaseCondition: These artifacts and their automated gate must be committed before the next release candidate is packaged.
